He's a reliable worker.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="5" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !Notes |- |[[File:roublesicon.png|link=Roubles]] |[[Roubles]] |~20,000 |Handover item |Used to pay the extraction fee |} In this quest you have to extract from [[Streets of Tarkov]] via the "Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex" extraction with the "survived" status.
